title: Rory and the Silver Fern Haven
verses:
The dark was falling soft and deep,
Across the silver valley floor,
As Rory led the way to sleep,
Where quiet waves would crash no more.

Then Nia swooped above the trees,
And watched the sleepy stars appear,
While Psittaco enjoyed the breeze,
And chirped that cozy night was near.

Beside a bed of velvet moss,
Now Ricky stopped his evening play,
A cozy fallen log across,
The quiet path to guide their way.

And Tilly found a silver stream,
Where Benny took a heavy rest,
That bubbled like a happy dream,
Beside a soft and cozy nest.

They gathered close as shadows grew,
Beneath the starry sky so deep,
Where quiet breezes softly blew,
To lull the sleepy world to sleep.

Now Rory closed his heavy eyes,
And curled up tight to dream all night,
Beneath the dark and peaceful skies,
Wrapped inside the quiet light.
